sections.voiceover: Dive teams at Abrams Falls recovered the body of 24-year-old Sahil Jilani after a days-long search.
Texas traveler Sahil Jilani was last seen at Riverstone Campground in Townsend at 8 p.m. on October 5. Park officials discovered his vehicle near the hiking trail. Where was the missing hiker found?

sections.voiceover: Divers searched Blount County waters for days, but the tragic discovery at Abrams Falls changed everything.
Recovery operations ended on October 8, 2026. Park officials confirmed his death in the Tennessee wilderness. Divers pulled him from Abrams Falls.
Park authorities recovered Sahil Jilani's body from Abrams Falls.
